camel_example: aliyun sas DeleteBackupSnapshot --region cn-hangzhou --BackupSnapshotList.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupRegionIdList.1 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupSnapshotList.1.SourceType ECS_FILE --BackupSnapshotList.1.InstanceId 'i-j6cj8vyajp1fo4at0000' --BackupSnapshotList.1.VaultId 'v-0004vhwcs2pmacfz0000' --BackupSnapshotList.1.SnapshotId 's-000f9p6r5trm6u4d0000' --BackupSnapshotList.1.ClientId 'c-000a4h33w14ka8xa0000' --RetainLatestSnapshot true
description_en: Deletes snapshots of anti-ransomware backups in Security Center
description_zh: 删除云安全中心服务器防勒索备份的快照
kebab_example: aliyun sas delete-backup-snapshot --retain-latest-snapshot true --backup-snapshot-list SnapshotId=s-000f9p6r5trm6u4d0000 InstanceId=i-j6cj8vyajp1fo4at0000 SourceType=ECS_FILE ClientId=c-000a4h33w14ka8xa0000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou VaultId=v-0004vhwcs2pmacfz0000 --backup-region-id-list cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBackupSnapshot

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the latest snapshot. Valid values:
true: retains the latest snapshot.
false: does not retain the latest snapshot
parameters.help_zh:
是否保留最新快照。
true：是
false：否
parameters.name: retain_latest_snapshot

fields.help_en:
The ID of the backup client.

You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain this parameter
fields.help_zh:
备份客户端ID。

调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口获取该参数
fields.name: client_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the server instance
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
The region of the Security Center instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou).
ap-southeast-1: Singapore.
cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
fields.help_zh:
云安全中心实例地域。取值为：

cn-hangzhou：  杭州
ap-southeast-1：  新加坡
cn-beijing：  北京
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the snapshot to delete.
You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain this parameter
fields.help_zh:
需要删除的快照ID。
调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数
fields.name: snapshot_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: backup snapshot of ECS files.
OSS: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud OSS.
NAS: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud NAS.
OTS_TABLE: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud Tablestore
fields.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：

ECS_FILE：ECS文件的备份快照。
OSS：阿里云OSS的备份快照。
NAS：阿里云NAS的备份快照。
OTS_TABLE：阿里云表格存储的备份快照
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The ID of the backup vault for the restoration task.
You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain this parameter
fields.help_zh:
恢复任务的备份仓库ID。
调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数
fields.name: vault_id
